selection_state: Registered before generating or visually reviewing this 100-example corpus; existing published SWARM research informs strata, never new output selection.
fixture_policy: Unchanged native fixture() geometry:192x112 and origin(-96,-56). Solo free uses whole eligible territory; hostile solo uses left side0. Pair native side0/side1 and identical seed/profile, without overrides.
failure_policy: Retain the exact identity, error log and native result of every registered case. No seed substitutions; diagnostics are supplementary and cannot count toward100. Genuine correctness defects suspend affected comparisons and require explicit correction and full affected replay.
analysis_policy: Review labels and benchmark selection occur after all100 are retained. No aggregate quality score. Components are descriptive, not physical support. Strong/ugly/brittle labels are judgments, not native truth.

phase_gates.B: Existing Windows evaluator must report; accepted exact combined source requires actual acceptance evidence, including physical Windows use, not a hosted or Linux-only inference.
phase_gates.C: Only after Phase A completion and accepted Windows freeze. No SWARM002 port/selection or Workbench bridge until then.
